verdict.rationale: The pack confirms an R2 product with creatable buckets that is part of the Cloudflare platform, and that Cloudflare Images can store and deliver images. It also says Workers reach storage via Bindings. No evidence explicitly describes R2 as object storage or shows a Worker writing user uploads to it, so support is thin. Missing for 10: explicit docs of R2 object storage and its Workers binding, an upload/put example for user-generated files, coverage of non-image file types, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist user-generated uploads using built-in object storage

citations.quote: Cloudflare Images helps teams build scalable, reliable media pipelines to store, optimize, and deliver images.
Connect to external services like databases, APIs, and storage via Bindings, enabling functionality with just a few lines of code
